responses.description: The Bomb Factory Art Foundation is a charitable arts organisation that transforms vacant buildings across London into vibrant cultural hubs. Over the last decade, we have provided affordable studios for artists, presented exhibitions that challenge the status quo, and run free public programmes that make art accessible to the communities we serve.
